_note: The coach market (GDD 4.9.1 'Who you can get, and when', 'Shown and scouted', 4.9.2 'A coach can end it'; session C6, read by CoachMarket, scripts/core/coach_market.gd). THE POOL: the coaches around a career are made once (their own dice from the athlete's name and birth date: same career = same coaches; the global dice are never touched) from the club's town in data/towns.json (size class by population, the SUL centre) and data/clubs.json, and kept in CoachSystem's records (fictional ones get ids mk_1, mk_2 ...; the real coaches of data/coaching.json `real` keep their ids). WHO YOU CAN GET: each group of coaches opens at an age (`ages`); the national and regional ones open earlier once the athlete has reached the TF-juniorit standard (`seen`: camp coaches see you); real coaches follow their kind, reputation and min_level; the world-level ones (spots 0) only ever approach the athlete themselves (`offers`). COACHES CHOOSE: spots this season and min_level on the 800 m ability scale (the coach asks for the time that ability runs, RacePerformance.time_for). SCOUTING: each attribute is shown as a range of `width` points with the true value somewhere inside it (not always the middle); asking around, a visit and looking at his athletes' results take points off the width of the attributes they show; working together narrows every range to the exact value over `together_weeks`. DISTANCE (user 2026-10-17: three steps): same town = full coaching; same region (maakunta) = 2 days a week with him, half the penalty; further = a remote coach (plan by message, monthly visits), weaker technique, load management and race reading at meets he skips. BUDGET (user: the tighter numbers): the family answer sets euros a month for coaching beyond the club fee (club fees always fit); a coach with no published fee costs the estimate of his reputation (user). ENDING (user: 6 + 4 + 4 weeks): weeks of Strained trust, then two warning talks, then he ends it and the athlete picks the next coach; a real coach's words are neutral and professional (user). Every number is a first guess for the balance session (B1).

seen._note: Reaching the TF-juniorit standard of your age (data/standards.json, Standards.time) opens the regional and national coaches whatever the age, and one of them may write to you (an offer).

tiers._note: Fictional coaches outside your own club. average = his overall level (mean, sd, min, max; then the personality's lean and his own spread as for club coaches, data/coaching.json club), cost = euros a month (personal coaching; club coaches of another club cost that club's fee, which always fits), spots = places this season [min, max] (0 = full; drawn again every season), min_level = the 800 m ability he asks for [min, max], group = training group size, age = his age range.

parent._note: A parent as coach: only with the creation answer 'A parent competed in athletics' (family athletics_parent). Free, open, a strong fit (data/coaching.json fit.kind_bonus) and some family friction (data/mind.json drift.stress.parent_coach). The parent's last name is the athlete's.

scouting._note: Width of the shown range (high - low) per attribute. Unknown: fictional coaches by reputation, real ones by `evidence` (how much is public about them), the parent `parent`; the head coach at the start of a career `head_start` (you have trained in his group before). Each step takes `attrs` points off those attributes and `other` off the rest, once per coach; `reveals` = the character words it shows (style, demands). Working together: the width falls in a straight line to 0 over together_weeks weeks.

distance._note: How far the coach is from the athlete's club town. The penalties are taken off the head coach's attribute (CoachSystem.attr); race_reading only at the meets he does not come to (he comes to `attends` levels and to the season's targets). A remote-kind coach is always far.

budget._note: Euros a month for coaching beyond the club fee (user 2026-10-17: the tighter numbers). Club fees always fit; a parent is free. Real money, grants and sponsors come with M4.

fees._note: A real coach with cost_month 0 and no published fee (personal or remote) costs the estimate of his reputation (user 2026-10-17); the screen says it is an estimate. Academy fees stay as in D1 (from the published notes, 0 = free).

offers._note: Coaches offer themselves (user 2026-10-17: 'whenever they deem it fit, if I'm slumping and they see I could do better etc.'; no ceiling, but a switch 'Open to offers'; never accepted from the message; the message as detailed as the coach is). Every Sunday night each coach who could take the athlete now (status ok: a place, the time, the budget; not the head coach, not a coach who ended it) weighs what HE sees, in points: `reasons` (talent = his read of the hidden potential minus the ability the athlete's best shows, x talent_per_point, only up to talent_max_age; slump = recent races clearly slower than the best and no best for a while, noticed with notice chance; progress = the best improved by progress_s in a year; crossed = a best that cleared his bar for the first time in the last crossed_days; seen = the TF-juniorit standard just reached; strained = trust Strained with the head coach for strained_weeks, FICTIONAL coaches only), plus better_per_point x (his average - the head coach's average, capped at better_cap) and minus fit_per_level x the gap between his group's level and the athlete's beyond fit_free. A score above `threshold` makes him write that week with chance (score - threshold) x chance_per_point (at most chance_max): the more he wants the athlete, the sooner he writes; a coach barely interested rarely bothers. At most one offer a week (the highest score), a coach writes again only after again_days (a new crossed or seen reason excepted), 'Not now' holds declined_days. His read has noise: sd = noise.floor + noise.per_point x (20 - judging ability) on every point he sees, so a poor judge writes for the wrong reasons and misses the right ones. His promise ('with me I think you could run X by next summer') = the time of (the ability the best shows + yearly_gain[age] x (1 + (his average - the head's) x self_belief_per_point + demands[his demands]) + his noise), so a poor judge or an ambitious coach overpromises; never more than promise_max_years years' gain, never slower than the best. The offer holds valid_days (his place is kept).
offers.minor_note: An athlete under minor_age is not written to directly (user 2026-10-18): the offer is told by a parent in the family thread (lines.parent_offer) and waits on the coach's page.
offers.attention_note: How much of the athlete a coach sees, by where he is listed (his weekly chance x this): the club's and the town's coaches see you at the track, the others only at meets now and then.

ending._note: User 2026-10-17: Strained for strained_weeks weeks in a row -> warning talk 1 (a stop); still Strained second_after weeks later -> warning talk 2; still Strained end_after weeks later -> he ends it (a stop: pick the next coach from those who would take you now, max_choices; no answer = the first). Trust back above Strained at any time resets the chain. The replies to a warning add trust.

plan_intro.real: In my group, the training would

plan.endurance_knowledge: build your aerobic base properly, with well-planned long runs and tempo work
plan.speed_strength_knowledge: add real speed and strength work, done right
plan.technique: clean up your running technique with drills every week
plan.periodization: plan the season round the meets that matter, so you peak on the day
plan.youth_development: keep you healthy through the growth years and make the most of them
plan.load_management: watch your load closely, so a niggle never becomes an injury
plan.race_reading: work on how you race: where to run, when to move, when to kick
plan.mental_coaching: work on your nerves and your race-day mind
plan.communication: always explain why we do what we do
plan.judging_ability: set goals that are right for you, not too low and not too high
